::: {.job-market-intro}

# Mutahir Sultan

[Ph.D. Candidate in Agricultural and Resource Economics<br>Colorado State University]{.job-market-affiliation}

I am an applied microeconomist working in environmental and resource economics and public policy. I study how agricultural producers respond to weather risk and policy, and how their decisions affect nearby and downstream communities.

My work focuses on drinking-water quality, downstream flood risk, and agricultural insurance. I use these settings to study who benefits from farm decisions, who bears the costs, and where policy can reduce risk.

[Research](research.qmd){.btn .btn-primary} [CV (PDF)](Mutahir_Sultan_CV.pdf){.btn .btn-outline-primary}

[Email](mailto:mutahir.sultan@colostate.edu) · [Google Scholar](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=xz34ZLYAAAAJ&hl=en) · [ORCID](https://orcid.org/0009-0002-0754-8565) · [GitHub](https://github.com/mutahirsultan111) · [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/mutahir-sultan-2507675a)
